decisions.question: When does Frozen expire?
alternatives: Controller-turn removal conditional on attack availability
decisions.discriminating_case: Freeze an exhausted enemy minion and inspect its next attack opportunity.

decisions.question: Does unqualified damage restrict side?
decisions.discriminating_case: Friendly hero or minion is an allowed selected damage target; only the freeze is enemy-wide.
